sources.snippet: This model separates drums, bass and vocals and other stems for any song. As Hybrid Transformer Demucs is brand new, it is not activated by default, you can activate it in the usual commands described hereafter with -n htdemucs_ft. The single, non fine-tuned model is provided as -n htdemucs, and the retrained baseline as -n hdemucs_mmi.

sources.snippet: What is HTDemucs? HTDemucs (Hybrid Transformer Demucs) is Meta AI's fourth-generation music source separation model, introduced in Hybrid Transformers for Music Source Separation (Rouard et al., ICASSP 2023).
